question.text: PIPE (Private Investment in Public Equity) is:

answer.text: Cat III AIF purchasing listed stocks at a discount (typically via preferential allotment)

explanation.text: The Logic: PIPE deals purchase shares of listed companies at a discount to market, typically through preferential allotments. The Trap: Other definitions don't match. Cross-Exam Context: Common Cat III strategy in India. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Check lock-in conditions and listing/regulatory compliance for PIPE deals.
